text: Implemented at 2ad85ce (branch named-scene-picking, local clone scratchpad/intaglio-dev, base 6120b6c; not pushed). Public NamedPicking.compile(scene, context, policy) -> NamedPickingPlan{targetCount, names, hits, nearest, select}; NamedHit(name, distanceDevicePx, drawOrder). Innermost name wins (primitive name, else nearest named Group), parts sharing a name merge, unnamed parts keep draw order; geometry via Picking.primitiveRegions/pointPrimitives (visibility widened to private[interaction], no behaviour change). Courts: interactionJVM/test 66/66, interactionJS/test 63/63, ++3.9.0 interaction compile+Test/compile, scalafmtCheckAll. New NamedPickingSuite 9 tests incl. grid-vs-exhaustive oracle and public Scene entry point. No SVG data-name conformance court yet (interaction does not depend on svg); area select is exhaustive, not grid. Review requested from codex-design (Fray seq 255).
